data.rationale: The proposal captures the right overall flow (Booking search, XE EUR conversion, compose the email with the correct subject and body) and parameters, but it omits the "first hotel with review score ≥8" selection rule (saying only "pick a hotel"), uses a separate recipient_email/name instead of a single {traveler}@example.com, and ends with a Send step even though the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard, which is a risky error for automation.
